LanguageData.CC_Settings_NextSteps_Tip: A short, ordered plan the council keeps with you, on the Plan page: each hour it proposes steps from what it watches (the priorities, the defense advice, an idle research bench), you take them into the plan or let them go, add your own, and order them. A step is done when you say so, or when the need behind it has passed. The first step shows on This week and the council panel.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_NextSteps: A Plan page: the council proposes the next steps, you keep the order.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlanButtons: Bottom bar buttons for Plan, Base, Making and Rearrange a room
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlanButtons_Tip: Four small buttons after the rooms button: the Plan, Base and Making pages, and the Rearrange a room tool. The pages are always on the council window too. Right-click a button to put it away under More on its own.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PlanButtons: Small buttons in the bottom bar for the Plan, Base and Making pages and for rearranging a room.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Sub: What to do next, in your order. The council proposes; you decide.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_HeaderTip: Each hour the council looks at the priorities, the defense advice and the research bench and proposes steps from them. Take a step into the plan, let it go, or add your own. A step is done when you say so, or when the need behind it has passed for a few hours.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Empty: Nothing planned yet. Take a step the council proposes, or add one of your own below.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_NothingProposed: Nothing to propose right now. The council looks again every hour.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_LetGoTip: Out of the plan. The council won't propose it again for a fortnight.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_RemoveOwnTip: Takes your step off the plan.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Research_Detail: The bench stands idle. {PROJECT} ({COST}) is a sensible next project for this colony.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_StepDone: Done, by the look of it: {STEP}.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_OwnHint: A step of your own, in a few words...
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Off: The colony's next steps are switched off in Rimfolk's settings (Council page).
LanguageData.CC_Ground_ButtonTip: Draws the rooms in the plan and the proposals on the map together, each at the spot that fits best with the ones before it kept clear: how the base grows if the plan is followed in order.
LanguageData.CC_Ground_Sub: The next rooms, each where it fits best with the ones before it kept clear. Plan them in this order and they fit together; the reasons are under each.
LanguageData.CC_Ground_Empty: Nothing to draw yet: take a room into the plan, or wait for the council to propose one.
LanguageData.CC_Ground_NoSpot: No spot near the colony where all of it can be built.
LanguageData.CC_Week_PlanProposedTip: Steps the council proposes, waiting for you on the Plan page.
LanguageData.CC_Spot_Title: Where should this go? Click a spot to see it.
LanguageData.CC_Spot_Noisy: next to a workshop or barn, noisy
